codeSubtitle: Six characters, from whoever runs Stampeo at your shop.
codeHelper: Ask your manager if you don't have it yet.
authSubtitle: We've kept your code. Choose how you want to sign in.
confirmRole: You'll be able to scan your customers' cards.
addBody: Enter the six-character code from whoever runs Stampeo there. Your current shop stays where it is.

errors.JOIN_CODE_INVALID: That code doesn't exist. Check it and try again.
errors.JOIN_CODE_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Ask your manager for a new one.
errors.JOIN_CODE_USED: That code has already been used. Ask your manager for a new one.
errors.JOIN_CODE_REVOKED: That code was cancelled. Ask your manager for a new one.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: You're already part of this team.
errors.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: This team is full. Your manager needs a bigger plan to add you.
errors.BILLING_REQUIRED: This shop's subscription has ended. Your manager can reactivate it.
errors.CHECKOUT_REQUIRED: This shop hasn't finished setting up Stampeo yet.
errors.BUSINESS_NOT_ACTIVE: This shop isn't active right now.
